item.title: First thoughts after watching Re:Zero season 4 episode 3
item.description:
I watched the Re:Zero season 4 episode 3. I remember the story for season 2 and 3 only a little, but don't remember the details of each character that much. At the last episode, Subaru and others fell down from the flower's fields. Subaru, Ram, Anastasia, and Patrasche arrived at the underground of the dune. He obviously saved Ram while falling down to the dune.

At first, he was anxious about Rem and lost his temper because if she is alone, she cannot do anything and be hurt. But Ram was chill and she tried to make him calm down. She also is worried about her, but I feel a little bit weird because Ram lost the memory of Rem. So she thinks Rem is important for her because of the fact that she is her sister? At least she got to the point that she reacted like she used to be before if there is a danger to Rem.

Then they started walking to the underground. And needed to choose 2 ways. Subaru was actually obsessed with Freud and always chose the right path because he had suggested. But then they got to the wall. Subaru thought it's a door but Ram and Anastasia thought it was just a wall. When he touched the door, then it disappeared. I was like, what the hell is going on? It obviously seals something, and Subaru has a weird power, maybe witch? or Sin Archbishop? so he was able to open it? But then, why did other two not recognize it as a door? Normal people didn't recognize it? Then after opening it, Patrasche reacted to it and warned us about the path after the wall. I thought there would be a strong mabeast there.

Then after that, Subaru opened the 2nd door, but then they got angry with each other while walking, lost taking care of others gradually. And then when they got to the 3rd wall, Subaru couldn't open the door. Why? Maybe he lost his miasma because he opened 2 doors already?

But at that point, they went nuts, and started killing each others. At first, Subaru and Ram. Then once Ram was killed by Anastasia, then he freaked out and was scared, so he overreacted. Then Anastasia was killed by Ram, probably. Then Patrasche killed Ram and then did him. The whole scene was insane and grotesque, especially the scene where Anastasia's lower body was cut and intestines were dropped.

Then he got back to the time when he woke up at the beginning of this scene. And sounded like these were caused by miasma. If there is a place with a strong miasma, and people are there for a long time, people lose their body and minds. Anyway, they went to the left path instead of right path on the cross road, and then Subaru was kind to others more and try to take a lead more. Others felt creepy about him because of that change. He compared to Julius but that behavior was natural for Julius but not Subaru.

Anyway, then went down, then Subaru went down to hall and there was a mabeast. It looks like Centaurs, half-horse man with spears instead of hands with weird head. Subaru went at first but then Ram jumped into them and tried to fight against it. At last, they couldn't win and she was trying to save him while the mabeast was attacking them, especially because of Rem. Both of them always says protecting and saving Rem in this episode.

But then, the woman who used lights came and killed the mabeast. Obviously, it's the same woman who shoot Subaru in the previous episode from the tower and then they saved her. Not sure what is her purpose and where she is, but it seems she is Shaula, the Sage.

I watched 2nd time. Actually, a music and the animation is great, as usual. The music after Subaru opened the wall sounds creepy and scary, as Re:Zero often does, and obviously show something goes wrong. Then when Subaru threw both lights out to somewhere when they were fighting, then the animation started showing only a dark blue animation. I still don't get what caused. It seemed Subaru was okay at first until he drank water, but then he lost the temper the fastest when the door wasn't opened. I thought he is resilient to miasma, but it seems it's not.

Also, he suddenly talked about miasma after this death, but I don't know why he thought it's because of miasma. Was there any symptom in this episode? Then they started fighting the centaurs' mabeast. It uses fires, and they noticed the smell of heat faster. Ram's El fula didn't damage it that much, but a new woman's attack hit a lot, so it clearly show how powerful this woman is.

item.title: First thoughts after watching Re:Zero season 4 episode 2
item.description:
I watched the Re:Zero season 4 episode 2. I remember the story for season 2 and 3 only a little, but don't remember the details of each character that much. This episode reminds me of Re:Zero and got me excited a little. Subaru and Emilia went to a pub and heard a rumor about the dune surrounding the Pleiades's tower. They said flying birds in the dune always go to the tower.

Then in the dune, there is a sandstorm. Stronger sandstorm than I thought, which makes even the tower harder to see. Then they left the sandstorm and arrived at the flower field. At this point, they went more than Reinhard could do. But then, there are bear Mabeasts in the field and many of them started chasing Subaru and others. Then, bang! Subaru's return by death started.

Until this return by death, all people joined in the group helped each other. Ram used Mabeast's eyes to find which way they should go by each Mabeast, Meili used a giant sandworm to remove hostile Mabeasts, and also tried to make the bear's Mabeasts go away in the flower fields. But the Joseph, Subaru's carriage's Mabeast, suddenly cried out and she failed to do so. Then of course, Emilia, Beako, and Julius attacked against Mabeasts attacking the carriage. I forgot, but surprisingly, Subaru can use more magic than he used to. Maybe I simply don't remember what he was able to do and learn during Season 3.

Why did the Joseph cry when the bears tried to leave them? Maybe they are afraid of them and want to eliminate instead of leaving? No idea if this is some kinds of important plots or just a random thing.

Anyway, after the return by death, Subaru was panic, which makes sense, and tried to avoid the death by going to a different direction on the 2nd time while fleeing from bears Mabeasts. But he noticed there was a light coming from the tower and crashed them and killed Joseph or Beako. Then on the 3rd try, he used his dark magic and prevented their Mabeast from crying out, and stayed in a place, but then the light still tried to attack Subaru. All of them, especially Julius, put that fall down and protected Subaru. We know he is strong since season 1, but shutting down the blazing-fast object by a sword was really good. Then Subaru used his magic to nullify the object but triggered breaking a barrier, and a hole opened beneath them and they fell down, and ended the episode.

By the way, Julius said Subaru was the one who knows him the most, but did he? Ignoring nameless thing, he is an elite knight and for sure he has more friends. Oh, but during the season 1, he said Subaru is his best friend, so kinda make sense. Considering that early, he might not have many friends in knights, or those knights were not alive, or he was promoted too early to Anastasia's knight and they left.

Watching 2nd time, I missed a lot about a few things. First, Julius stroked Joseph's chin on the early scene and he calmed them down, which helped Subaru to do the same on the later scene. Also, Julius lost an ability to use his spirits, so fights and putting the light down was by his physical ability only. Also, Emilia ordered hot milk in a desert in the day. Is there any background that she actually can protect from the heat because she can use ice magics? Then Ram's left eye was bleeding when the light was coming from the Tower, but why? She cannot use her ability because it's for mabeasts but not others, so by what?

Anyway, let's see what's going to happen in the next episode.

item.title: First thoughts after watching Re:Zero season 4 episode 1
item.description:
I watched the Re:Zero season 4 episode 1. In the last season, Subaru fought against multiple Sin Archbishops with royal candidates of Lugunica's next ruler and their knights. And in the season, Julius was forgotten by everyone by the end. Also, Subaru got a dragon's cursed leg and arm instead of flesh.

It started with a scene where they met outside and talked about him, confirming that everyone except Subaru had forgotten him. Then Anastasia suggested to meet with the Sage in Lugunica, Shaula. They are the one of the greatest heroes: the sword saint, who is obviously Reinhard, Dragon lord, I don't know who, and the Saint. The saint could save him from the nameless state, which was the curse of Gluttony. It's the 1st time hearing that Saint and wondered what he did for an entire time. It seems the Sage keeps their eyes on the seal for the Witch, obviously, but then what does Dragon lord do?

Anyway, partway through the journey, Subaru suddenly realized that Anastasia is not actually herself. She is Echidna, which happens to be the same name as Echidona, the Witch of Greed, but the different. She is a fox in the fur worn by Anastasia, and she was an artificial spirit. I was a little bit confused, from when she became Echidna, or Foxidna? After season 4? Or was she actually from season 3? At least Priscilla noticed her too, so perhaps during season 3 but I forgot. But she wasn't hostile, so it's probably not a big issue.

Then Subaru and others arrived at the Mansion of Roswaal's and met with a few people there. And then he tried to pick up Rem because the saint could save her like Julius, too. Subaru talked to Rem. That scene really pretends to show like she is a main heroine in this series. But at least it shows how Subaru is greedy that he wants to save everyone and also thinks Rem is special to him, though Emilia is the first.

Then he also met a girl. I think she was on the season 1 who uses wolves to attack a Roswaal's village. I didn't expect her to appear again and also started going with them. But the place where the Saint lives sounds like surrounding by the Mabeasts, and she can use them, so that's why he needed helps from her.

Then at the last, Garfield met with his mom, who forgot who he is and then told him her kids' names, which turned out to be Frederica and Garfield. Then Garfield was satisfied with his mom, perhaps because he wasn't forgotten completely and he missed her a lot. He is actually 15 or 16 if I remember correctly, and he was without his parents, so it's touching scene.

This episode is just a start, and it tried to show a lot of scenes here and there. Let's see what's going to happen, and when a loop will start.
